title: The Buddha's first sermon at Sarnath
timeLabel: Traditional account: around the fifth century BCE; dates contested
shortSummary: Early Buddhist texts and later heritage traditions remember Sarnath as the place where the Buddha taught his first disciples.
curatorialDescription: Event, text and site remain separate: the discourse is a transmitted teaching, Sarnath is a real archaeological place, and later pilgrimage memory is not compressed into one undifferentiated biography.
researchNote: The event uses a broad traditional range. The transmission of SN 56.11, archaeological layers and the modern World Heritage narrative require separate reading.

sources.title: Early Buddhist texts in the Pāli canon: MN 26 and SN 56.11
sources.locator: MN 26 Ariyapariyesanā：求法与到达鹿野苑；SN 56.11 Dhammacakkappavattana：鹿野苑初转法轮文本
sources.role: Primary-text entry for Buddha biography, early teaching traditions and the Sarnath setting; the transmitted discourse is not treated as a verbatim transcript
